purpose: Acquire WM-811K raw dataset (file was listed in handoff manifest but absent on disk)
limitations: No independently published checksum compared beyond the one recorded in this project's own PACKAGE_CONTENTS.json.

purpose: Select up to 1000 unique maps per class (Center/Edge-Ring/Scratch/none), deduplicate, and perform a lot-aware 70/15/15 train/val/test split
limitations: Lot-to-split assignment uses a deterministic greedy deficit-based bin-packing heuristic, not an exact optimal partition; achieved proportions (70.03/15.00/14.98) are close to but not exactly 70/15/15.

purpose: Convert selected raw wafer maps to fixed 32x32x2 float32 tensors (die-present / defective-die channels) with nearest-neighbor resize and centered zero padding
limitations: Example figures saved for 2 samples per class only (8 total); visual spot-check, not an exhaustive audit of all 4000 samples.

purpose: Train Model A (hidden=16), evaluate quantized validation macro-F1 against the 0.85 quality target, and (since it fell short) train and quantize Model B (hidden=32) under the identical protocol, then select between them using quantized validation macro-F1 only
limitations: Quality target (macro-F1 >= 0.85) was NOT met on the test split (0.7709). Per the prompt's explicit instruction, the threshold/labels/test data were not altered and no further architecture search was performed; this result is reported as-is and the functional (processor+TFLM) demonstration proceeds using Model B regardless.

purpose: Clone and pin tflite-micro at a specific commit for both the native reference and firmware builds
limitations: Shallow clone (--depth 1); full history not retained.

purpose: Build and run the native x86 TFLM reference oracle (same pinned commit, reference kernels, and model bytes as the firmware) over all 20 comparison cases
limitations: Two build issues fixed during this run: (1) deleted signal/ and kissfft/ subtrees needed restoring (micro_mutable_op_resolver.h unconditionally includes a signal-processing kernel header); (2) flatbuffers::ClassicLocale::instance_ needed third_party/flatbuffers/src/util.cpp (not header-only).

purpose: Build the bare-metal RV32IM firmware (crt0 + newlib + pinned TFLM reference kernels + embedded model/inputs)
limitations: Required linking against newlib+libstdc++ (not -nostdlib, unlike the processor directed tests) since TFLM needs memcpy/memset/new/delete; required sw/platform_rv32/{syscalls.c,debug_log.cc,flatbuffers_locale_stub.cc} and .init_array handling in crt0.S.

purpose: Run the firmware on RTL via Animas/Zenith; first attempt after the static-initialization bug fix

measured_results.milestone_reached: MMIO_MEASURE cycle=351185 value=1 (Invoke() for case 0 started)
measured_results.bounded_probe_result: a separate run with +MAXCYCLES=5000000 reached SIM_TIMEOUT still inside case 0's Invoke()

limitations: 0 of 20 cases completed within session wall-clock time; see docs/issues.md and docs/handoff/limitations_and_open_questions.md for the Animas tool-connectivity behavior encountered while orchestrating this long-running job (headless-mode jobs appeared to continue/restart independently of the MCP tool call's own timeout, and output was block-buffered, making live progress monitoring unreliable).
